summary: Sandbach United suffered a narrow 1-0 defeat to New Mills at Hind Heath Road in what was a closely contested match, with the visitors breaking the deadlock against the run of play around the 27-minute mark. Despite fielding an unchanged side following their important win over Stafford on Saturday, The Bach couldn't find an equalizer despite creating several promising opportunities, including a Hatton header that struck the crossbar. Nolan picked up a yellow card for a late challenge as Sandbach pressed for a way back into the game in the closing stages.
